title: END CARDS: CLOSE X, NO COPY REPORT, CLEAN HAUL REVEAL
why: The critic scored the end cards 2 and 3: no close X (his Q43: a dialog is a card with an X), copy report is a dev action on a player card (moved to the one recorder page in Settings, Q8 reason in changes.md), and during the haul reveal a tile popping in at 1.5x looked like a stray box beside the strip.
now: Every end card has a 48px X top right that leaves like the primary. Copy report is gone from the card. Haul tiles not yet shown are empty slots, and each settles in instead of flashing big.
